about: P3 Home on time: Spanish-first subject: OTR dry van with a sign-on bonus and 401k.

brief.subject: Conductor Clase A de larga distancia

recipe.name: P3 Home on time
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with being home, then the facts that make it true.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our truck pulling into a quiet {street} at dusk, a porch light on, no people, no text, no logos, no lettering
recipe.motion_template: The truck rolls to a stop as the porch light comes on

en.primary_text: Out 2 weeks, home 3 days — that's how this run works, every time. Dry van, over-the-road, coast to coast. You earn $0.70 per mile plus a $2,500 sign-on bonus. Need 2 years of experience and to be 23+. 401k included. Apply and get rolling.
en.headline: $0.70/mile, coast to coast.

es.primary_text: 2 semanas en ruta, 3 días en casa — así funciona siempre. Van seco, costa a costa. Ganas $0.70 por milla más bono de entrada de $2,500. Se requiere 2 años de experiencia y ser mayor de 23 años. 401k incluido.
es.headline: $0.70 por milla, costa a costa.

en.primary_text: Dry van, over-the-road. Coast to coast runs, out 2 weeks, back home 3 days. You know the schedule before you leave the yard. Pay is $0.70 per mile. $2,500 sign-on bonus for qualified drivers. 401k. Must have 2 years experience and be 23+.
